hello! i loved the piece you did for me previously and would be so thrilled if you could draw another original character for me!

appearance:
- his right eye is considerably paler than his left eye, which is grey! 
- beauty mark on the tip of his nose. 
- two eyebrow piercings on the right side of his face, and a lip ring. 
- his face has a lot of scars. the scars include what look like little stitches (or "X"-es) at the corners of his lips.
- hair is black, messy, and covers most of his ear piercings. aside from the detailed/ornate ones he wears on his right ear, he wears two plain silver studs on his lobe on his left ear.
- wears sunglasses around a lot because his eyes are sensitive! 
- he is also always seen with a plain chain necklace around his neck.
- i would love if you could add some blue forget-me-not tattoos on his arms! 

profile:
- his age is unknown, but estimated to be about 24/25. 
- darker skin
- 190 cm. he has an athletic build.
- he dresses like a punk. a lot of ripped clothing, tattered/old clothes in general. his body is always too warm/hot and he works as a mechanic, so he likes to keep his clothes loose. 
- he has an easygoing/relaxed expression to his face that can come across as haughty and unapproachable sometimes, but he's actually gentle-hearted. he doesn't remember any of his past, and he can't speak as a result of lingering trauma, but he tries his best to work hard and be useful!
- because he cannot speak due to trauma, he uses his phone to type out messages for the most person. contrary to his tough appearance, he texts in a very cute way.

i have included reference images in the link, but leave all composition and other aspects up to you. the second appearance reference removes his bangs so you can see his facial features more clearly. 

thank you for your consideration! please feel free to turn down the request for any reason!!

- 首、胴体、腕などにあざや包帯を巻いていることが多い。
- 非常にゆったりとした流れるような服を着ている。
- 手には常に手袋をはめ、首には太い黒のチョーカーを巻いている。

- 傷や怪我を特に恥じてはいないが（知性に反して体は比較的弱い）、きつい服装は好まない。
- イメージ：銀杏の葉、秋、スズメ、医療器具（メスなど）、肋骨／骨

ありがとうございます！どんな理由でも遠慮なく断ってください！
